title.narrative: Sustaining universal coverage of malaria interventions to achieve elimination - Gambia (01-Jul-2021-30-Jun-2024)

description.narrative: Gambia, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Republic of The Gambia (Ministry of Health)This program has the following goals: Attain zero malaria deaths in all regions of the country. Achieve zero indigenous malaria transmission in all regions of the country. The objectives of this program are: By 2025, all malaria cases at all levels receive prompt diagnosis and effective treatment according to the national guidelines. To achieve at least 90 percent coverage of appropriate preventive interventions for all populations at risk of malaria in all transmission strata by 2025. At least 90% of the population at risk are protected with effective malaria preventive therapies. By 2025, at least 90% of the population have appropriate knowledge and practice use of malaria prevention and management services. By 2025, strengthen malaria surveillance, monitoring and evaluation and operational research systems at all levels to improve decision making for programme. By 2025, strengthen malaria programme management and partnership capacities at all levels for the optimal implementation of interventions to achieve elimination
